towns.name: Baishi
towns.summary: Baishi ('white rock') was founded by Sho settlers who followed the Snowflake Range south-west of Shoushi to the foot of the Linvak mountains and built in a wooded dale ringed by snow-capped peaks; it is home to the Sho spice merchant and the Derethian Combat Arena. The town of green-roofed halls, a church and dome houses (z 54) sits in a clearing among 30-50 m giant pines, with the Town Network portal, a Life Stone, a well, green-glowing lanterns and a nullified golem statue on its pedestal in the square. The Seven Stars Tower, a 31 m octagon, stands in a small glade to the south, and a ring of twelve settlement portals hides in the pine forest to the east.
